description: This file is a test script for the Git file system monitor (fsmonitor) implementation. It includes setup, execution, and verification of fsmonitor daemon behavior with various filesystem operations, submodule interactions, Unicode handling, and platform-specific cases.

methods.name: stop_daemon_delete_repo
methods.description: Stops the fsmonitor daemon and deletes the specified repository directory.

methods.name: start_daemon
methods.description: Starts the fsmonitor daemon with optional parameters for trace files and tokens.

methods.name: have_t2_data_event
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a Trace2 data event with specified category and key.

methods.name: verify_implicit_shutdown
methods.description: Verifies if the daemon has shut down implicitly by checking daemon status within a timeout.

methods.name: edit_files
methods.description: Modifies certain files and directories to trigger filesystem change events.

methods.name: delete_files
methods.description: Deletes specific files and directories to test fsmonitor reaction.

methods.name: create_files
methods.description: Creates new files and directories for filesystem event testing.

methods.name: rename_files
methods.description: Renames files and directories to generate move events.

methods.name: file_to_directory
methods.description: Converts a file to a directory to test directory changes.

methods.name: directory_to_file
methods.description: Converts a directory back into a file for testing filesystem changes.

methods.name: move_directory_contents_deeper
methods.description: Moves directory contents into a subdirectory, testing nested directory change events.

methods.name: move_directory_up
methods.description: Moves a subdirectory up in the directory hierarchy.

methods.name: move_directory
methods.description: Renames a directory.

methods.name: clean_up_repo_and_stop_daemon
methods.description: Resets and cleans the test repository and stops the daemon.

methods.name: test_unconfig
methods.description: Unconfigures a Git setting, e.g., core.fsmonitor.

methods.name: matrix_clean_up_repo
methods.description: Cleans the repository for testing matrix configurations.

methods.name: matrix_try
methods.description: Performs a test case for specific untracked cache and fsmonitor configurations.

methods.name: create_super
methods.description: Creates a superproject repository with certain files for submodule testing.

methods.name: create_sub
methods.description: Creates a submodule repository with specific files.

methods.name: my_match_and_clean
methods.description: Checks the status consistency between the main repo and its state with fsmonitor disabled.

methods.name: start_git_in_background
methods.description: Starts a Git command in background with process supervision.

methods.name: stop_git
methods.description: Stops a background Git process.

methods.name: stop_watchdog
methods.description: Stops the background watcher process.
